cues.name: sfx.katana.swing.light
cues.desc: Short, bright blade whoosh (120-180 ms) with a thin high-frequency edge; air cut, no metal ring.

cues.name: sfx.katana.swing.medium
cues.desc: Fuller whoosh (200 ms) with a low body and a clear blade 'hiss' tail; reads heavier than light.

cues.name: sfx.katana.swing.heavy
cues.desc: Committed two-hand swing (280 ms): cloth snap on the wind-up, deep air displacement, long hiss tail.

cues.name: sfx.katana.swing.rising
cues.desc: Upward launching cut: whoosh with an upward pitch sweep (+3 semitones over 250 ms) to sell the lift.

cues.name: sfx.katana.swing.charged
cues.desc: Released charge: heavy swing layered with a pressure-release 'thump' and a short ember crackle.

cues.name: sfx.katana.swing.fullmoon
cues.desc: Full-charge crescent: massive whoosh, reversed bowed-metal swell into the cut, 1.2 s shimmering tail.

cues.name: sfx.katana.swing.overhead
cues.desc: Falling overhead chop: descending whoosh with a sharp stop at the bottom; weight on the end.

cues.name: sfx.katana.swing.low
cues.desc: Quick low cut near the floor: short whoosh plus grass/grit brush layer.

cues.name: sfx.katana.swing.sweep
cues.desc: Wide ground sweep: long horizontal whoosh with floor scrape on the leading edge.

cues.name: sfx.katana.thrust
cues.desc: Stepping thrust: tight, pointed air pierce (100 ms) with a foot-slide pre-layer.

cues.name: sfx.katana.sheathe
cues.desc: Blade sliding into the scabbard, click of the collar at the end; quiet and precise.

cues.name: sfx.katana.iai
cues.desc: Draw-cut from the sheath: metallic 'shing' with a silent gap then a razor air-split.

cues.name: sfx.katana.rush
cues.desc: Dash-slash approach: wind rush Doppler-panned with the fighter, footfall bursts.

cues.name: sfx.katana.dragon
cues.desc: Ascending Dragon: rising spiral whoosh with a sub-bass swell and ember roar layer.

cues.name: sfx.katana.wind
cues.desc: Severing Wind launch: blade cut that turns into a howling wind gust travelling away.

cues.name: sfx.katana.charge.start
cues.desc: Blade drawn back: low metallic hum that begins to rise; loops seamlessly for the charge hold.

cues.name: sfx.charge.full
cues.desc: Charge-ready tell shared by all weapons: bright bell ping + ember flare, identical pitch so players learn it.

cues.name: sfx.katana.slash.cinematic
cues.desc: Cinematic cut inside ultimates and executions: exaggerated layered slash with reverse swell and sharp transient.

cues.name: sfx.ultimate.katana.start
cues.desc: Thousand Oaths activation: time-stop 'inhale' (low-pass sweep) then a taiko hit and blade ring.

cues.name: sfx.ultimate.katana.final
cues.desc: Final cut: every previous slash released at once, big sub drop, glassy shatter tail of 2 s.

cues.name: sfx.execution.katana.final
cues.desc: Execution final blow: silence gap, single clean cut, heartbeat thump, ember scatter tail.

cues.name: sfx.movement.dash
cues.desc: Forward dash: fast cloth whip and two quick footfalls on the arena surface.

cues.name: sfx.movement.backstep
cues.desc: Backstep: short scuff and cloth flutter, lighter than dash.

cues.name: sfx.movement.roll
cues.desc: Roll: body tumble on the floor, armour rattle, soft impact on the shoulder.

cues.name: sfx.movement.sway
cues.desc: Dodge sway: quick torso whip of cloth, nearly silent; the perfect-dodge sound is separate.

cues.name: sfx.movement.techroll
cues.desc: Tech roll recovery: hand slap on the floor then a roll; sounds deliberate and controlled.

cues.name: sfx.throw.reach
cues.desc: Grab attempt: gauntlet or hand whoosh and cloth tug.

cues.name: sfx.throw.connect
cues.desc: Grab connects: collar seized, armour clack, short grunt-free body jolt.

cues.name: sfx.throw.impact
cues.desc: Body slammed to the ground: heavy thud, armour crash, surface debris layer.

cues.name: sfx.mode.rage
cues.desc: Ember Rage ignition: fire roar swelling from the chest, war-drum hit, crackling loop tail.

cues.name: sfx.mode.shadow
cues.desc: Umbral Shadow: reversed whisper choir, tearing cloth-like sever, cold sub hum loop tail.

cues.name: sfx.mode.rage.end
cues.desc: Rage fades: embers hiss out, drum decays; clearly signals the buff is over.

cues.name: sfx.mode.shadow.end
cues.desc: Shadow fades: the echo snaps back into the body with a soft reversed thump.

cues.name: sfx.echo.strike
cues.desc: Shadow echo hit: the original impact replayed through a dark reverb and pitched down 5 semitones.

cues.name: sfx.impact.light
cues.desc: Light hit on flesh or cloth for the attacker's weapon family: sharp transient, short body, no ring.

cues.name: sfx.impact.heavy
cues.desc: Heavy hit: layered transient + low body thump + debris; 30% longer tail than light.

cues.name: sfx.impact.counter
cues.desc: Counter hit: heavy impact plus a pitched metallic 'ring' so skilled play sounds skilled (vision doc §7).

cues.name: sfx.block.light
cues.desc: Guarded hit: metal-on-metal clash, short and dry.

cues.name: sfx.block.heavy
cues.desc: Guarded heavy hit: grinding clash with a push-back scrape.

cues.name: sfx.parry
cues.desc: Perfect parry: bright bell-like clang, gold shimmer tail (400 ms); the most rewarding sound in the game.

cues.name: sfx.perfectdodge
cues.desc: Perfect dodge: whoosh that inverts into a reversed swell; world audio ducks for Shadow Time.

cues.name: sfx.counterstance.catch
cues.desc: Counter stance catches a strike: blade 'kiss' then silence (60 ms) before the reprisal.

cues.name: sfx.armor.absorb
cues.desc: Hit absorbed by armor: dull thud with a low metallic resonance, no pain reaction.

cues.name: sfx.guardbreak
cues.desc: Posture broken: glass-like shatter over a heavy clang, then a ringing tinnitus tone (250 ms).

cues.name: sfx.body.launch
cues.desc: Victim launched: upward whoosh of body and cloth.

cues.name: sfx.body.wallbounce
cues.desc: Body hits the arena wall: stone/wood crunch (surface switch) plus debris trickle.

cues.name: sfx.body.groundbounce
cues.desc: Body slammed into the floor and bouncing: heavy thud and dust burst.

cues.name: sfx.throwtech
cues.desc: Throw tech: two hands slapping apart, quick clash, cloth snap.

cues.name: sfx.clash
cues.desc: Projectile clash: two energies cancelling, crackling burst.

cues.name: sfx.projectile.dissipate
cues.desc: Projectile expires: soft wind puff fading out.

cues.name: sfx.knockout
cues.desc: Knock-out hit: heavy impact, then all combat sound ducks under a single low drum.

cues.name: sfx.finisher
cues.desc: Finisher: knock-out layered with a sustained choir chord and ember scatter.

cues.name: foley.step.slide
cues.desc: Foot sliding to a stop on the arena surface (surface switch: stone, wood, snow, water, ash).

cues.name: foley.step.plant
cues.desc: Weighted foot plant before a strike (surface switch).

cues.name: foley.step.jump
cues.desc: Take-off push from the floor (surface switch).

cues.name: foley.step.land
cues.desc: Landing on both feet with knee absorb (surface switch).

cues.name: foley.cloth.roll
cues.desc: Cloth and light armour tumbling during a roll.

cues.name: foley.cloth.heavy
cues.desc: Heavy robe and armour shift as the fighter sets a stance.

cues.name: foley.grab
cues.desc: Hands seizing collar and armour straps.

cues.name: foley.body.fall
cues.desc: Body falling to the floor (soft knockdown), armour settle.

cues.name: foley.body.slam
cues.desc: Body slammed flat (hard knockdown), breath forced out, debris.

cues.name: foley.body.rise
cues.desc: Getting up from the floor: hand push, armour creak, cloth.

cues.name: vo.effort.light
cues.desc: Short exhale or 'hup' on light attacks; never a word.

cues.name: vo.effort.medium
cues.desc: Firmer grunt on medium attacks.

cues.name: vo.effort.heavy
cues.desc: Full-body effort shout on heavy attacks.

cues.name: vo.effort.special
cues.desc: Named-technique shout (short, in-world language style, 0.4-0.8 s).

cues.name: vo.effort.throw
cues.desc: Grab effort: sharp inhale or clipped grunt.

cues.name: vo.effort.charge
cues.desc: Charging breath: slow controlled inhale building tension.

cues.name: vo.effort.stance
cues.desc: Counter stance: calm, quiet exhale; the absence of effort is the point.

cues.name: vo.ultimate.call
cues.desc: Ultimate activation line (1-2 s), character-defining; see voice direction.

cues.name: vo.ultimate.final
cues.desc: Ultimate closing line before the final cut.

cues.name: vo.execution.line
cues.desc: Execution line spoken to the broken opponent (quiet, cold, 1-2 s).

cues.name: vo.mode.rage
cues.desc: Ember Rage ignition roar.

cues.name: vo.mode.shadow
cues.desc: Umbral Shadow invocation whisper, doubled with the character's shadow voice.

cues.name: vo.hurt.light
cues.desc: Victim pain grunt on light hits.

cues.name: vo.hurt.heavy
cues.desc: Victim pain cry on heavy and counter hits.

cues.name: vo.hurt.guardbreak
cues.desc: Stunned gasp when posture breaks.

cues.name: vo.hurt.knockout
cues.desc: Defeat cry or last breath.

cues.name: vo.announcer.round
cues.desc: Round call: one line per round number 1-5 plus 'Final Round'; the event value selects the line.

cues.name: vo.announcer.fight
cues.desc: Fight call at round start, sharp and short.

cues.name: vo.announcer.timeover
cues.desc: Time over call.

cues.name: vo.announcer.ko
cues.desc: Knock-out call.

cues.name: vo.announcer.finisher
cues.desc: Finisher call, more intense than the knock-out call.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.light
cues.desc: Thin ink-white ribbon trail (SG_Weapon_Trail), 6-frame fade, 0.04 m wide at the tip; tinted by the fighter's mode.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.medium
cues.desc: Wider ribbon (0.07 m) with brush-stroke alpha breakup and a few ink flecks.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.heavy
cues.desc: Thick brush-stroke ribbon (0.12 m) with ember edge glow, ink droplets flung along the arc.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.launcher
cues.desc: Upward arc ribbon with rising sparks that continue 0.5 m above the tip.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.overhead
cues.desc: Vertical descending ribbon, heavier at the bottom, ink splash where it ends.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.low
cues.desc: Short low ribbon hugging the floor plus grass/dust wisps.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.sweep
cues.desc: Wide horizontal floor-level ribbon with a dust wake.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.air
cues.desc: Airborne slash ribbon, slightly longer fade (8 frames) so it reads during jumps.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.spike
cues.desc: Diagonal downward ribbon with a heavy end-cap pointing at the floor (spike read).

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.thrust
cues.desc: Straight thrust streak from the tip (1.2 m), sharp tapered end, small shockwave ring.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.charged
cues.desc: Charged ribbon: ember-orange core, white-hot edge, sparks shed along the arc.

cues.name: vfx.trail.katana.ultimate
cues.desc: Gold-white Oath-light ribbon with calligraphy glyphs dissolving along it.

cues.name: vfx.slash.fullmoon
cues.desc: Full-moon crescent (3 m diameter) of white-gold light, expanding shockwave ring on the floor.

cues.name: vfx.slash.iai
cues.desc: Single horizontal razor line across the screen plane (2.5 m) that splits then fades like cut paper.

cues.name: vfx.slash.crescent
cues.desc: Crescent Rush slash arc (1.8 m) trailing ink afterimages of the dash.

cues.name: vfx.slash.dragon
cues.desc: Rising spiral of ember ribbons shaped like a serpent (2.8 m tall), sparks shed at the peak.

cues.name: vfx.slash.wind.launch
cues.desc: Launch burst of the Severing Wind: pale teal crescent leaving the blade plus dust ring.

cues.name: vfx.slash.ultimate.katana
cues.desc: One of six cinematic cuts: screen-crossing gold lines at varied angles, ink bursts on the victim.

cues.name: vfx.slash.execution.katana
cues.desc: Execution cut: single thin line of Oath-light, delayed ink burst 4 frames later.

cues.name: vfx.charge.katana.start
cues.desc: Charging: embers drawn inward along the blade, faint heat haze; loops until release.

cues.name: vfx.charge.katana.full
cues.desc: Charge full: blade flashes white-gold once, then steady glowing edge (readiness tell).

cues.name: vfx.stance.stillwater
cues.desc: Stillwater stance: concentric ripple rings on the floor under the fighter, calm blue-grey.

cues.name: vfx.ultimate.katana.aura
cues.desc: Ultimate aura: gold Oath-light calligraphy spiralling around the body, background desaturates.

cues.name: vfx.ultimate.katana.final
cues.desc: Final cut: all six slash lines flare at once and shatter into ink and gold petals.

cues.name: vfx.execution.reach
cues.desc: Execution reach: a brief gold glint on the hand and blade as a readable grab tell.

cues.name: vfx.execution.katana.final
cues.desc: Execution final: ink spray arc and slow-falling embers (blood-free by design).

cues.name: vfx.throw.reach
cues.desc: Grab tell: small white spark at the reaching hand.

cues.name: vfx.impact.ground.slam
cues.desc: Blade hits the floor: radial crack decal, debris chunks (surface switch), dust ring 2 m.

cues.name: vfx.impact.ground.throw
cues.desc: Body slammed by a throw: dust burst and floor debris under the victim.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.dash
cues.desc: Dash kick-up: dust puffs behind the heels, surface-tinted.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.backstep
cues.desc: Backstep: small dust puff in front of the toes.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.roll
cues.desc: Roll: dust trail along the roll path.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.techroll
cues.desc: Tech roll: hand-slap dust burst then roll trail.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.sweep
cues.desc: Sweep: arc of dust following the blade along the floor.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.rush
cues.desc: Rush start: burst of dust and a streak of afterimage ink behind the fighter.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.jump
cues.desc: Take-off dust ring.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.land
cues.desc: Landing dust ring, larger on heavy landings.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.launch
cues.desc: Victim launched: upward dust and cloth-fibre streaks.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.fall
cues.desc: Soft knockdown: dust puff where the body lands.

cues.name: vfx.movement.dust.slam
cues.desc: Hard knockdown: dust ring and small debris.

cues.name: vfx.movement.afterimage
cues.desc: Dodge afterimage: 2 ink-silhouette copies of the fighter mesh fading over 12 frames (mesh-based, not particles).

cues.name: vfx.mode.rage.ignite
cues.desc: Ember Rage ignition: flames burst from the chest outward, body gains an ember rim light.

cues.name: vfx.mode.rage.burst
cues.desc: Rage burst shockwave: expanding ember ring (2.2 m) matching the burst hitbox.

cues.name: vfx.mode.rage.fade
cues.desc: Rage ends: embers drift off the body and die out.

cues.name: vfx.mode.shadow.sever
cues.desc: Umbral Shadow: the fighter's shadow tears free from the floor as violet-black ink, inverted rim light.

cues.name: vfx.mode.shadow.fade
cues.desc: Shadow ends: the echo silhouette dissolves (SG_Umbra_Dissolve) back into the floor.

cues.name: vfx.echo.strike
cues.desc: Echo hit: violet-black ink slash repeating the original arc, inverted colours.

cues.name: vfx.hit.light
cues.desc: Light hit: small white-ink spark star (0.4 m) with 4-6 flecks, 1-frame white core.

cues.name: vfx.hit.heavy
cues.desc: Heavy hit: larger spark star (0.8 m), shock ring, ember flecks, 2-frame white core.

cues.name: vfx.hit.counter
cues.desc: Counter hit: heavy hit plus gold ring and radial speed lines (reads 'COUNTER' without text).

cues.name: vfx.blood.light
cues.desc: Ink-like blood spray (dark crimson-black, painterly droplets) in the hit direction.

cues.name: vfx.blood.heavy
cues.desc: Heavier ink-blood arc with 1-2 floor decals (decals fade after 6 s).

cues.name: vfx.blood.finisher
cues.desc: Finisher spray: long painterly arc frozen for the slow-motion beat, then falling.

cues.name: vfx.block.light
cues.desc: Guard spark: short orange-white metal sparks at the blade contact.

cues.name: vfx.block.heavy
cues.desc: Heavy guard spark: bigger shower plus a push-back dust skid under the defender.

cues.name: vfx.parry
cues.desc: Parry: white-gold flash star, circular shock ring and slow-falling gold motes.

cues.name: vfx.perfectdodge
cues.desc: Perfect dodge: 6-frame colour inversion (post-process), ink afterimage left at the dodge start.

cues.name: vfx.counterstance.catch
cues.desc: Counter stance catch: ripple ring bursting from the contact point, water-like.

cues.name: vfx.armor.absorb
cues.desc: Armor absorb: dull amber flash on the body surface, no sparks.

cues.name: vfx.guardbreak
cues.desc: Guard break: shattering glass-like shards of the posture bar colour, stun stars of ink.

cues.name: vfx.wallbounce
cues.desc: Wall bounce: crack decal and debris burst on the wall plane (surface switch).

cues.name: vfx.groundbounce
cues.desc: Ground bounce: floor crack decal, dust ring and debris.

cues.name: vfx.throwtech
cues.desc: Throw tech: two small spark bursts between the hands.

cues.name: vfx.clash
cues.desc: Projectile clash: two coloured energies spiralling and bursting.

cues.name: vfx.projectile.dissipate
cues.desc: Projectile dissipates: wisps unravelling in the travel direction.

cues.name: vfx.knockout
cues.desc: Knock-out: huge ink burst frozen during slow motion, background desaturates to charcoal.

cues.name: cam.shake.light
cues.desc: Light positional shake for light contact.

cues.name: cam.shake.medium
cues.desc: Medium shake for heavy contact and throws.

cues.name: cam.shake.heavy
cues.desc: Heavy shake for slams, bounces and guard breaks.

cues.name: cam.shake.ultra
cues.desc: Ultra shake reserved for full-charge, ultimate and finisher blows.

cues.name: cam.push.heavy
cues.desc: Subtle dolly-in during heavy wind-ups to sell commitment; releases on recovery.

cues.name: cam.push.charge
cues.desc: Slow dolly-in while charging; resets on release or cancel.

cues.name: cam.push.throw
cues.desc: Throw framing: dolly toward the pair for the slam.

cues.name: cam.push.stance
cues.desc: Counter stance: slight push to build tension.

cues.name: cam.push.rush
cues.desc: Rush: short push that leads the fighter's travel direction.

cues.name: cam.push.special
cues.desc: Generic special-move push.

cues.name: cam.execution.prompt
cues.desc: Execution attempt: stronger push toward the broken opponent.

cues.name: cam.tilt.rise
cues.desc: Rising special: camera tilts up to keep the apex in frame.

cues.name: cam.tilt.launch
cues.desc: Launch: brief upward tilt following the victim.

cues.name: cam.zoom.mode
cues.desc: Mode activation: FOV punch-in then ease back.

cues.name: cam.zoom.counter
cues.desc: Counter hit: tiny FOV punch.

cues.name: cam.zoom.parry
cues.desc: Parry and counter-stance catch: FOV punch.

cues.name: cam.zoom.perfectdodge
cues.desc: Perfect dodge: slow FOV punch during Shadow Time.

cues.name: cam.ultimate.flash
cues.desc: Ultimate activation flash (photosensitivity-capped).

cues.name: cam.ultimate.katana
cues.desc: Authored Thousand Oaths camera (Timeline + Cinemachine), 150 frames, returns to gameplay framing.

cues.name: cam.execution.katana
cues.desc: Authored katana execution camera, 120 frames.

cues.name: cam.slowmo.finisher
cues.desc: Finisher slow motion (presentation pacing only).

cues.name: cam.slowmo.knockout
cues.desc: Knock-out slow motion (presentation pacing only).

cues.name: haptic.light
cues.desc: Light tick for light contact.

cues.name: haptic.medium
cues.desc: Medium pulse for heavy contact, parries and bounces.

cues.name: haptic.heavy
cues.desc: Strong pulse for guard breaks, full-charge and final blows.

cues.name: haptic.mode
cues.desc: Rising pulse on Rage or Shadow activation.

cues.name: haptic.charge.full
cues.desc: Charge-ready tick (gameplay tell, important on mobile).

cues.name: haptic.ultimate
cues.desc: Ultimate activation and final blow.

cues.name: impact.hit.light
cues.desc: Light hit: small spark, light blood, dry impact and a short shake; victim grunts half the time.

cues.name: impact.hit.heavy
cues.desc: Heavy hit (knockdowns, launches, bounces, Heavy/Charged/Ultimate moves): bigger spark, blood arc, thump, medium shake.

cues.name: impact.hit.counter
cues.desc: Counter hit: heavy hit plus gold ring, pitched ring sound and a small FOV punch so counters are unmistakable.

cues.name: impact.hit.paired
cues.desc: Scripted hit inside a throw, execution or ultimate: blood, heavy thump and pain cry (the move adds its own slash).

cues.name: impact.block
cues.desc: Guarded hit: metal sparks and a dry clash; no camera shake so blocking stays calm.

cues.name: impact.block.heavy
cues.desc: Guarded heavy hit: bigger sparks, grinding clash, light shake to sell the push-back.

cues.name: impact.parry
cues.desc: Perfect parry: white-gold star, bell clang and FOV punch; the most rewarding feedback in the game.

cues.name: impact.perfectdodge
cues.desc: Perfect dodge into Shadow Time: colour inversion, reversed swell and a slow FOV punch.

cues.name: impact.counterstance
cues.desc: Counter stance caught a strike: ripple burst and blade kiss before the reprisal.

cues.name: impact.armor
cues.desc: Hit absorbed by armor: amber body flash and a dull thud, no reaction from the victim.

cues.name: impact.guardbreak
cues.desc: Posture broken: shattering shards, glassy clang, stunned gasp, heavy shake and strong haptic.

cues.name: impact.launch
cues.desc: Victim launched into a juggle: upward dust streaks, body whoosh, camera tilts to follow.

cues.name: impact.wallbounce
cues.desc: Wall bounce: wall crack decal, debris, body crunch (surface switch) and heavy shake.

cues.name: impact.groundbounce
cues.desc: Ground bounce: floor crack, dust ring, body slam and medium shake.

cues.name: impact.knockdown.soft
cues.desc: Soft knockdown: dust puff where the body lands plus body-fall foley.

cues.name: impact.knockdown.hard
cues.desc: Hard knockdown: dust ring, body-slam foley and a light shake.

cues.name: impact.jump
cues.desc: Jump take-off: dust ring at the feet and push-off foley (surface switch).

cues.name: impact.land
cues.desc: Landing from any jump: dust ring and landing foley (surface switch).

cues.name: impact.grab
cues.desc: Grab connected: hands seize the collar, armour clack; the throw move adds its own cues.

cues.name: impact.throwtech
cues.desc: Throw tech: spark burst between the hands and a slap-apart clash.

cues.name: impact.clash
cues.desc: Projectile clash: two energies spiral and burst with a light shake.

cues.name: impact.projectile.end
cues.desc: Projectile expired or finished hitting: wisps unravel with a soft puff.

cues.name: impact.rage.end
cues.desc: Ember Rage ended: embers drift off the body and hiss out.

cues.name: impact.shadow.end
cues.desc: Umbral Shadow ended: the echo silhouette dissolves back into the floor.

cues.name: impact.echo
cues.desc: Umbral Shadow echo strike: inverted ink slash replaying the arc through dark reverb.

cues.name: impact.knockout
cues.desc: Knock-out: frozen ink burst, desaturation, slow motion, announcer call and heavy shake.

cues.name: impact.finisher
cues.desc: Knock-out by a finisher: knock-out layers plus blood arc, choir chord, deeper slow motion and ultra shake.
